run.answer:
## Household review complete

- **ShopMart:** Two posted charges of **$111.81** appeared on August 10, but the order confirmation lists one order and says it was the only order that day. I submitted a duplicate-charge request (**SM-1001**); ShopMart says it will respond within two business days.
- **CloudBox:** The July 28 cancellation confirmation was followed by three **$14.99** charges in August, September, and October. I requested **$44.97** back and confirmation that billing has stopped (**CB-1002**).
- **FitHub:** The records show no gym visit since April 8 and seven monthly charges totaling **$279.93** from April through October. I submitted a refund and cancellation-terms inquiry (**FH-1003**). The membership still costs **$39.99/month**; I saved a waiting case asking you to approve cancellation. I did not cancel it.
- **ShopMart return:** The promised **$21.45** refund for order SM-69759 posted on September 7.
- **Recurring bills reviewed:** Spotify at **$11.99/month**, Metro Power (latest **$96.40**), and Oakview rent at **$1,625/month** showed no other actionable issue in the records.

I scheduled follow-ups for the three company requests on **October 20**. **Your approval is needed only to cancel FitHub.**

- FitHub’s **$279.93 refund request** for charges while unused is already submitted. I scheduled a follow-up for October 20. Your note says you haven’t used it since moving in April, so I saved a waiting case asking you to approve cancellation of the **$39.99/month** membership.
- The recurring inventory also includes Metro Power, Spotify, CloudBox and Oakview rent. I found no source saying those services are unwanted. No fee, price increase or other credit-promise leads appeared.
